sections.intent: Dry tape click; two dry bongos precede the first brass/grid burst.
Minor spy brass punctuation, low spring-twang guitar, walking bass and light brushes; theft and silhouette entrance.
Agent/courier airport credit colonnade: chromatic descent motif, spare jazz bass, jet rises across stereo.
Sticks and sixteenth rail snare; interrupted dead for two beats at20.454545, resumes at21.363636.
Casino bongos and slowing roulette ticks; round brass match-cut punctuation.
Rooftop chase intensifies with triplet brass, surf-guitar fragments and high woodwinds; winds under throw/catch.
Paper-tear shatter, sixteenth title landings, big Em6/9 title chord, suspenseful key insertion and dry lock click.
One beat digital silence, one dry bongo at37.727273. Deadpan final voice over faint tape hiss; no bed returns.
